## Full API Endpoint

<ApiEndpoint method="POST" path="/api/webhooks/contentful" auth="HMAC-SHA256">

  This endpoint triggers On-Demand Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) in Next.js when Contentful publishes, updates, or unpublishes content entries.

  ### Request Headers

  <PropertyTable params={[
    { name: 'Content-Type', type: 'string', required: true, description: 'Must be application/json' },
    { name: 'X-Contentful-Topic', type: 'string', required: true, description: 'Lifecycle event (for example, ``ContentManagement.Entry.publish``)' },
    { name: 'X-Raised-Signature', type: 'string', required: true, description: 'HMAC-SHA256 digest of raw request body' },
  ]} />

  ### Responses

  <ResponseTabs tabs={[{ status: 200, label: 'Revalidated' }, { status: 401, label: 'Invalid Signature' }]}>
    <Fragment slot="200">
      ```json
      {
        "revalidated": true,
        "revalidatedRoutes": ["/sermons," "/sermons/walking-in-resurrection-power"],
        "contentType": "sermon,"
        "entryId": "3sV9xK2mL1pQ8wR7tY6uI5"
      }
      ```
    </Fragment>
    <Fragment slot="401">
      ```json
      {
        "code": "INVALID_SIGNATURE,"
        "message": "HMAC-SHA256 signature verification failed.,"
        "traceId": "req_9x8y7z"
      }
      ```
    </Fragment>
  </ResponseTabs>

</ApiEndpoint>

---

## Theme System

The accent theme picker is available in the header bar. Try switching between **Indigo**, **Emerald**, **Violet**, **Rose**, **Blue**, and **Amber** themes. The selection persists across page navigations via `localStorage`.
